name: Yume 1.5 (720p)
model_version: Yume 1.5: Yume-5B-720P (distilled, 4 Euler steps, sigma shift 7.0, no CFG) on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B; code stdstu12/YUME (fastvideo/sample/sample_5b.py loop)
notes: Interactive world model (text + keyboard/camera as text). Text OR image start (t2v and i2v tracks). 1280x704 at 16 fps, 32-frame (8-latent) segments generated live with upstream's long-video loop: all history kept, compressed by upstream's multi-ratio memory. Each segment has its own caption (upstream per-segment captions); the caption is '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>', and camera_control text goes in verbatim (Yume's keyboard/camera control is text). Image start = upstream I2V first segment (center-cropped). Mid-session reference images have no model input (reference_update unsupported).
